verdict.rationale: Deel Immigration is a SaaS mobility platform, so letting users configure background automations is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only built-in automated visa-expiry and renewal reminders. Those are fixed vendor notifications, an adjacent feature, not automations a user sets up to run autonomously, so there is no direct evidence for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
